name: dashboard-language
description: Add a language to the training dashboard (Claude translates its texts)

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: The language, e.g. German; empty = the language of this chat

name: dashboard-widget
description: Make a new widget for the training dashboard from your idea

arguments.name: idea
arguments.description: What the widget shows, e.g. my longest ride each month

name: training-dashboard
description: Build a personal training + recovery dashboard (volume, load, HRV, sleep) from Garmin data

arguments.name: weeks
arguments.description: Number of weeks to cover, default 12

name: training-dashboard-update
description: Update an existing training dashboard with the Garmin data since its last build (builds a new one when there is none)

arguments.name: weeks
arguments.description: Weeks to cover; empty = keep the weeks of the existing dashboard
